name: Keratinocyte
failures: Blistering from structural gene defects, impaired wound healing, malignant transformation.

see.note: Directly visible and biopsy is trivial.

model.note: Healthy epidermis is unambiguous and continuously renewed.

reach.note: Topical. Vyjuvek is a gel applied to the wound.

edit.note: Vyjuvek, topical HSV-1 vector for dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa, FDA 2023.

verify.note: Wound closure is observed by eye.
